name: dhdna-profiler
tagline_zh: 一段文字，看穿一个人的思考习惯。不是玄学，是认知模式提取——从措辞、逻辑到偏好，像DNA测序一样分析思维。
tagline_en: From any text, extract cognitive fingerprints—how they reason, choose words, and think. Not magic, but pattern.
desc_en: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mi
why_zh: 同类工具只做情感分析，它却拆解逻辑链、隐喻偏好和决策风格，输出可对比的思维画像。
why_en: Unlike sentiment tools, it maps reasoning chains, metaphor habits, and decision style into a comparable cognitive profile.
